title: Treatment response assessment of glioma tumors using deep learning based on magnetic resonance imaging
summary: U-Net segmentation and transfer-learned classification are applied to MRI before and after glioma radiotherapy, with the segmented volumes used to assess treatment response in 49 patients; this is a specific clinical imaging result.
ai_technology: U-Net segmentation and transfer-learned MRI classifier
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: U-Net segmentation and transfer-learned classification are applied to MRI before and after glioma radiotherapy, with the segmented volumes used to assess treatment response in 49 patients; this is a specific clinical imaging result.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Segments glioma volumes on pre- and post-radiotherapy MRI and classifies treatment response in the reported 49-patient cohort.
